evals.name: split-messy-working-tree
evals.prompt: This working tree has a mix of feature, refactor, formatting, and debug changes. Prepare it for review: propose commits and a PR description. Do not change behavior beyond organizing the change.
evals.expected_output: Splits commits by concern, separates refactor/formatting from feature, writes imperative messages, includes why/how verified/risk/rollback, and removes debug code.
assertions: Proposes splitting the change into coherent commits by concern
PR description includes why, how verified, risk, and rollback
Calls out and removes debug code or formatting noise
Does not mix unrelated changes in one commit
